g.text: destructive overlap sensitivity; batch wait ≤ 1 s

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Each threshold uses its own fully observed reception-anchored cohort; messages without full follow-up are excluded from that denominator.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Pending eligible messages miss that threshold but remain unresolved for eventual authentication. Curves are modeled verification-service completion.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Follow-up after capture: 60 s; finite observation horizon, with no authentication-age expiry. One deterministic seed (1); no confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Destructive overlap is an uncalibrated sensitivity model: one collision domain, all overlaps erased, no power/capture effects.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Hardware profiles: sender embedded_reference; receiver embedded_reference. Composite embedded references mix platforms and include lineage proxies; no aircraft
